statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, r equals the mirror M(root), where M is defined recursively by M(Null)=Null and M(Node(v,L,R))=Node(v,M(R),M(L)). Equivalently, every node keeps its value, its left and right subtrees are exchanged, and this is done recursively throughout the tree.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: For every root satisfying the preconditions, invert_tree root returns Result.ok r for some Tree r; it does not fail or raise an error.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, nodes(r)=nodes(root), where nodes(Null)=0 and nodes(Node(v,L,R))=1+nodes(L)+nodes(R).
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, for every integer x, occurrences(x,r)=occurrences(x,root), where occurrences(x,T) is the number of nodes in T whose value is x.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, height(r)=height(root), where height(Null)=0 and height(Node(v,L,R))=1+max(height(L),height(R)); this height counts nodes on a longest root-to-leaf path.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, for every depth d>=0, the list of values of nodes at depth d in r, read left-to-right, is the reverse of the list of values of nodes at depth d in root, read left-to-right. The root has depth 0 and absent children are omitted from the lists.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, for every finite path p of L/R moves that is valid in root, the path complement(p) is valid in r and value_at(r,complement(p))=value_at(root,p), where complement swaps L and R in every position. A path is valid when starting at the root and following its moves reaches an existing node; the empty path is valid exactly for a non-Null tree, and value_at gives the value of that reached node.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, for every finite path p of L/R moves, p is a valid path in r if and only if complement(p) is a valid path in root, where complement swaps L and R in every position. A path is valid when following it from the root reaches an existing node; the empty path is valid exactly for a non-Null tree.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: For every root satisfying the preconditions, whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r and invert_tree r returns Result.ok s, we have s=root.
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].

statement: Whenever invert_tree root returns Result.ok r, leaves(r)=leaves(root), where leaves(Null)=0, leaves(Node(v,Null,Null))=1, and for a node with at least one child leaves(Node(v,L,R))=leaves(L)+leaves(R).
preconditions: root is a finite Tree with at most 100 nodes, and every node value in root lies in [-100,100].
